intent: At 30fps, an unrepaired mid-frame loss requests one key frame 200-240 ms after the revealing packet (gap NACK round trip is read-driven, so the bound depends on fps), not at the 2 s expiry. The expiry's own report coalesces into it. RED when the early gap request is removed (first request at ~2 s). A request that ignores the NACK window still passes here; the 5 and 3.4 fps seeds catch it.
